description: This file defines the CredentialProvider class which contains various static methods to create and manage AWS credential providers, including environment-based, ini file-based, assumed roles, web identity, and caching. It enables flexible credential management and chaining for AWS SDK in PHP projects.

classes.name: CredentialProvider
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate various AWS credential providers, including environment, ini files, assumed roles, SSO, ECS, instance profiles, web identity, and caching mechanisms. It supports chaining multiple providers and handles credential retrieval and refresh logic.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default credential provider chain that checks environment variables, Web Identity, SSO, credential process, ini files, ECS, and EC2 instance profiles, with optional caching.

methods.name: fromCredentials
methods.description: Creates a static credentials provider from a given CredentialsInterface object.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates an aggregate provider that invokes multiple providers in sequence until credentials are obtained.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache its credentials and refresh as needed.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache credentials in a provided cache backend.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Provides credentials from environment variables AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.

methods.name: instanceProfile
methods.description: Provides credentials from EC2 instance profile metadata.

methods.name: sso
methods.description: Provides credentials from AWS SSO profiles, supporting both current and legacy formats.

methods.name: ecsCredentials
methods.description: Provides credentials via ECS credentials endpoint.

methods.name: assumeRole
methods.description: Provides credentials by assuming an IAM role.

methods.name: assumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
methods.description: Provides credentials by assuming a role using a web identity token.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Provides credentials from AWS credentials ini files, supporting role assumption and static credentials.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Provides credentials via a credential process defined in ini files.

methods.name: loadProfiles
methods.description: Loads profile data from specified ini files, combining credentials and config profiles.

methods.name: loadDefaultProfiles
methods.description: Loads profiles from default ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.aws/config files.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromSource
methods.description: Retrieves credentials based on the credential_source specified in profile data.
